llm.summary: This skill is a narrow QName AI CLI usage guide with disclosed API-key setup and no bundled code, persistence, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: Use of a QName API key and networked CLI commands is expected for the purpose; users should prefer ephemeral secret handling where practical.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install script, dependency installation, executable payload, or remote code retrieval is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives scoped command examples and explicit non-goals, with a minor locale-default note for keyword research and guidance to override country and language when needed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The documented init command implies local CLI configuration, but there is no evidence of background services, privilege escalation, tool hijacking, or cross-session agent persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is terminal access to QName AI WHOIS, traffic, and keyword research, and the instructions stay within those functions and key-approved quotas.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust QName AI and have an approved API key. Prefer short-lived environment variables or an interactive secret flow over placing a real key directly in shell history, and set keyword country/language options when the US/English defaults do not match your task.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The US and English Google Ads defaults are disclosed and overrideable; this is a usability/localization caveat, not a material security concern.
[T09] expected: The command-line API key setup can expose a real key through shell history or process metadata, but credential use is expected for this API client and the artifact also warns to treat the key as secret.
